text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock D after a modest gain felt rewarding, but I should not let the pleasure of realizing gains alone decide when to exit.","My account value rose overall despite some monthly declines, reminding me that short-term fluctuations need not prompt a trade.","Because I check infrequently and trade rarely, I should make each decision deliberately from the stock’s prospects and my overall needs, not just whether its price is above my cost."]}
